Renee Park: Quick question — my Day 1 orientation invite jumped by an hour after DST started here. The invite shows 09:00 but my calendar moved it to 10:00. Did the exporter handle DST?
Omar Khan: Hi @Renee — we had one sync that used floating timezones which don't respect DST boundaries for some clients. Sorry about that.
Renee Park: Ugh. I almost missed breakfast with the hiring manager. Any quick fix?
Leah Turner: For now, set your calendar display timezone explicitly to your local zone (Google: Settings > Time zone). Accept the event labeled "(local)" — that one is generated with the correct zone offset.
Renee Park: Where do I see that label? On mobile it's truncated.
Omar Khan: Open event details — we add "(local)" at the end of the summary and a one-line note in the description. Mobile truncation is being handled in the exporter patch.
Onboard Bot: @channel Recording and captions flow: Zoom cloud -> processing -> onboarding S3 (presigned link posted in this thread) -> VTT transcript posted alongside -> archive to Drive/Notion within 48h.
Accessibility Team: Quick accessibility note — can we surface the live caption toggle in the orientation Zoom invites and include a link to the transcript location in the ICS? That helps folks who rely on captions.
Calendar Team: Good idea. We'll add a short note in the ICS: "Live captions available in Zoom; recording & VTT posted to #new-hires." We'll also add a metadata field clients can surface. Patch planned tonight.
Renee Park: Thanks — also the invite was sent as a recurring "3-day series" for some people; I only want the single events blocked.
Omar Khan: That was a bug in the legacy cohort template. We now send separate events for Day 1/Day 2/Wrap. If you have a series, decline it (don't send response) and accept the individual ones labeled "(local)". We'll remove the recurrence from the template.
Legal: FYI on recordings: retention policy is 90 days for onboarding recordings, after which we archive them to a restricted bucket for audit purposes. If you need longer retention for compliance training, send a request to learning@redwood.ai.
Leah Turner: Useful. Renee — if your presigned link expires, search this thread for Onboard Bot or DM me and I can request a 14-day extension.
Renee Park: Perfect — and please ping here when the DST exporter patch is live; I want to re-check my calendar.
Calendar Team: Patch scheduled: calendar-exporter v3.4 -> staging 03/29 23:00 UTC, prod 03/30 03:00 UTC. Will post status in this thread when deployed.
Renee Park: Awesome, thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
